description:
Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.

We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.

Why You’ll Love This Role

As a core member of Cribl’s global People Operations team, the International People Operations Analyst, Benefits oversees the administration and coordination of benefits and leave programs throughout EMEA and APAC, while offering targeted support for US and Canadian benefit plans. Reporting to the Director of International People Operations, this role serves as the internal subject matter expert on international benefits—owning program administration, supporting renewals and roadmap delivery, and ensuring employees across all regions have access to competitive, compliant benefits delivered smoothly.

A strong command of benefits technology and AI tooling is central to how this role operates. We’re looking for someone who actively uses AI and modern benefits tech to automate routine tasks, improve documentation quality, and scale benefits delivery as Cribl grows.


As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will…

  • Regional Benefits & Leave Delivery: Oversee global benefits and statutory leave administration across EMEA and APAC, ensuring accurate, timely delivery and strict alignment with local labor and compliance requirements.
  • Strategic Execution & Renewals: Partner with the Director of International People Operations and the US Benefits Manager to execute roadmap initiatives, including new plan implementations, open enrollment/annual renewals, and ongoing plan optimization.
  • Employee Escalations & Experience: Serve as the primary point of contact for complex benefits inquiries and escalations, delivering prompt, empathetic, and accurate resolutions.
  • Vendor & Broker Management: Cultivate strong partnerships with local vendors and international benefits brokers (e.g., Marsh) across vendor onboarding, plan changes, billing/invoice audits, and annual renewals. 
  • Global Expansion: Scope, benchmark, and deploy statutory and supplementary benefits packages for new international entity launches.
  • Data & Compliance Integrity: Maintain benefits data accuracy across HRIS, payroll, and carrier/broker portals while proactively monitoring regional statutory changes and compliance risks.
  • AI-Driven Operations: Drive the adoption of generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, Serval) to streamline benefits workflows, automate repetitive tasks, analyze renewal data, and draft localized employee communications.
  • Benefits Tech Optimization: Assess and deploy benefits technologies that reduce manual administration, scale effortlessly across regions, and elevate the employee experience.
  • Knowledge Architecture: Build and maintain self-serve (T0) and first-line (T1) knowledge bases—including AI-assisted agent guides, localized plan summaries, and FAQs—to enable fast, consistent query resolution.
  • Systems & Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate with HR Tech, Payroll, and broader International People Ops on Workday/broker portal configurations, onboarding, and regional HR workflows where benefits and systems intersect.
  • We are a remote-first company and work happens across many time-zones – you may be required to occasionally perform duties outside your standard working hours 


If You’ve Got It - We Want It

  • 5+ years of experience in HR Operations or People Ops, with deep hands-on experience in international benefits administration.
  • Expert knowledge of benefits in at least 2–3 EMEA and/or APAC markets where Cribl operates (e.g. UK, Germany, France, Netherlands, Italy, Poland, Sweden, Israel, Australia, Singapore) — covering statutory requirements, broker management, and local plan design.
  • Working familiarity with US and/or Canadian benefits (e.g., medical, dental, vision, 401(k)/RRSP, HSA/FSA, Open Enrollment).
  • Demonstrated experience using generative AI tools to improve HR/People Ops workflows, automate routine tasks, and produce clear, scalable documentation.
  • Strong technical aptitude with benefits platforms, HRIS (Workday preferred), Google Workspace, Slack, and Jira.
  • Exceptional organizational skills, discretion with sensitive employee data, and the ability to manage competing priorities asynchronously across global time zones (including regular overlap with US Pacific hours).
  • Fluent in English; proficiency in an additional European or APAC language is a plus.

Bring Your Whole Self

Diversity drives innovation, enables better decisions to support our customers, and inspires change for the better. We’re building a culture where differences are valued and welcomed, and we work together to bring out the best in each other. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.

Interested in joining the Cribl herd? Learn more about the smartest, funniest, most passionate goats you’ll ever meet at cribl.io/about-us.
